options: very qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatilmaydi — much bigger
questions.explanation: Katta farq: much/far/a lot/considerably; kichik farq: a bit/slightly.
even better, still worse — oldingi holatga nisbatan yanada kuchli.

questions.text: «nowhere near as good as» nimani anglatadi?
options: Umuman yaqin ham emas — ancha yomonroq
questions.explanation: as...as qoliplari: not as cold as, twice as big as, nowhere near as good as.

questions.text: «the best I've ever seen» — qaysi zamon bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: Superlative + ever doim Present Perfect talab qiladi.

questions.text: «The more you practise, the better you get» — bu qanday qurilma?
questions.explanation: ...er and ...er esa o'sish jarayonini bildiradi: colder and colder.
Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa DO/DOES/DID qo'shiladi.

questions.text: «No sooner...» qaysi so'z bilan davom etadi?
questions.explanation: Hardly/Scarcely ... WHEN; No sooner ... THAN (Past Perfect + Past Simple).

questions.text: «Only when I left did I appreciate it» — inversiya qayerda?
questions.explanation: Only when I LEFT (oddiy tartib) → did I appreciate (inversiya).
Here comes the bus (ot — inversiya) ↔ Here it comes (olmosh — inversiya yo'q).
Under no circumstances, On no account, Little did I know — kuchli ta'sir vositalari.

questions.text: «It was John who called» — bu qanday qurilma?
questions.explanation: It + is/was + ta'kid + that/who + qolgan gap.

questions.text: «What I need ___ a holiday» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Wh-cleft doim BIRLIK fe'l oladi.

questions.text: «What he did was ___ call» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: Harakat ta'kidlanganda (to) + V1 keladi.

questions.text: «I DO love you» — «do» bu yerda nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Emphatic do/does/did + V1 — inkorni rad etish yoki tasdiqni kuchaytirish.

questions.text: «All (that) I want is...» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: The reason (why)..., The thing (that)..., All (that)... — cleft muqobillari.
Uch tur: bog'lovchi + gap; ravish + yangi gap; predlog + ot/-ing.
although (gap) | however (yangi gap) | despite (ot).
because/since + gap ↔ because of/due to + ot.
for example/instance, such as, namely — misol keltirish guruhi.
therefore, consequently — natija ravishlari, nuqtali vergul bilan.

questions.text: «despite of the rain» — bu nega xato?
options: «despite» dan keyin «of» kelmaydi; «in spite OF» esa to'g'ri
questions.explanation: despite + ot; in spite of + ot — ikkisini chalkashtirmang.

options: even though — fakt; even if — faraz
questions.explanation: Even though it rained (yog'di) ↔ Even if it rains (yog'sa ham).

questions.text: «however hard I try» — so'z tartibi qanday?
questions.explanation: no matter how/what/who/where ham shu qolipda ishlaydi.

questions.text: «Although it rained, but we went» — bu nega xato?
questions.explanation: Bittasini tanlang — ikkalasi bir vazifani bajaradi.
even so, all the same ham shu guruhga kiradi.
because of, due to, owing to, on account of, thanks to + ot.
Thanks to your help, we finished on time.
such + (a) + (sifat) + OT + that; so + sifat/ravish + that.

questions.text: «so many books that...» — «so many» nima bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: so much + sanalmaydigan; so many + sanaladigan.
therefore, consequently, as a result, thus, hence — rasmiy natija ravishlari.

questions.text: «I came for help» — bu nega noto'g'ri?
options: Fe'l bilan «to» ishlatiladi: I came to help
questions.explanation: «-uchun» uch xil: to (fe'l) / for (ot) / so that (boshqa odam).

options: so as not to / in order not to + V1
questions.explanation: «to not» qurilmasi xato hisoblanadi.

questions.text: Ega boshqa bo'lganda maqsad qanday beriladi?
questions.explanation: I left early so that she could rest.

questions.text: «in case» dan keyin qaysi zamon keladi?
questions.explanation: in case ≠ if: in case — oldindan ehtiyot; if — shart bo'lsa keyin.

questions.text: «with a view to» dan keyin qaysi shakl keladi?
questions.explanation: with a view to / with the aim of + -ing — rasmiy maqsad qoliplari.

options: by — muddat («...gacha bo'lgan nuqta»); until — davomiylik («...gacha davom»)
questions.explanation: Finish it by 5 ↔ Wait until 5.
for two hours ↔ during the meeting.
consist OF, deal WITH, benefit FROM, object TO, succeed IN.
Ot + predlog: reason FOR, solution TO, difference BETWEEN, increase IN, effect ON.

options: in London → on Oxford St → at number 5
questions.explanation: Kengdan torga: in (hudud) → on (ko'cha) → at (aniq nuqta).
eat up, speak up, grow up — zarracha ma'noni belgilaydi.
find out, run out, work out.
think over, take over, get over.

questions.text: «put up with it» — olmosh qayerda turadi?
questions.explanation: Separable + olmosh o'rtada (turn it on); inseparable va three-word — oxirida.
calm down, write down, break down.
